weeks.content:
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
Pupils should be able to -
1. Mention sources of food nutrients.
2. List three nutritional diseases.
1. Sources of Food Nutrients
2. Nutritional Deficiency Diseases

PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
Pupils should be able to -
1. Describe the characteristics of nutritional deficient persons.
2. Describe the consequences of family size on nutrition.
1. Characteristics of Deficiency Diseases
2. Family Size and Its Effect on Nutrition

PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
Pupils should be able to -
1. State briefly history and development of Judo in Nigeria.
2. State the importance of Judo.
1. History of Judo
2. Importance of Judo
